title: Saan Galing ang Kuryente sa Bahay?
premise: Daytime: solar supplies the home first; surplus can be exported under net metering or charge a battery. At night: battery or grid.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

sources: Sources: Meralco Solar & Net Metering and DER pages;
U.S. DOE Homeowner's Guide to Going Solar (checked 24 Nov 2026)

cues.text: Saan nga ba galing ang kuryente sa bahay mo?
Habang may araw, solar ang unang sumusuplay sa bahay.
Kapag sobra, puwedeng i-export sa grid kung naka-net metering.
Kung may battery, puwede rin itong mag-charge.
Sa gabi, battery o grid na ang nagsu-supply.
Kapag alam mo ang daloy, mas madaling magtipid.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: While generating, a solar system supplies the home first.
claims.caveats: Depends on load at that moment.

claims.wording: Surplus solar can be exported to the grid under net metering.
claims.scope: Net-metered customers in the Meralco franchise area.
claims.caveats: Requires an approved net-metering application; export credit is not one-for-one at retail.

sources.title: Solar-plus-storage / Homeowner's Guide to Going Solar
excerpts: Batteries can store solar energy produced during the day for use at night or during outages, if the system is designed for it.

sources.title: Distributed Energy Resources
excerpts: At times when there is no sunlight, or at night, the grid will provide electricity.

sources.title: Solar and Net Metering
excerpts: Your system supplies the property first while it is generating.
The Meralco grid supplies the property when renewable generation is not enough.
Exported energy is credited under net metering.

caption.main:
Saan galing ang kuryente sa bahay? Araw: solar muna. Sobra: export sa grid (net metering) o charge ng battery. Gabi: battery o grid. 🏠☀️

SoSmart viewers, net metering o battery: alin ang mas bagay sa inyo? 👇
